sources.title: Cypress AI
sources.snippet: Cypress AI is the set of AI capabilities built into the tools you already use (the Cypress App and Cypress Cloud), rather than a separate product to adopt. In the Cypress App, cy.prompt turns a plain-language description into real Cypress commands, and Studio AI suggests selectors and assertions while you record.
